## Trial report

I added three tasks:

- “Buy oat milk”
- “Book dentist appointment”
- “Plan Saturday errands: return library books, collect the parcel, and pick up ingredients for dinner”

### What worked

- Adding tasks was straightforward, and the remaining count updated to “3 left.”
- Checking “Buy oat milk” marked it complete with a strike-through and changed the count to “2 left.”
- I renamed “Book dentist appointment” to “Schedule dentist check-up.”
- Individual **Delete** buttons worked.
- I ultimately tidied up by deleting all test tasks individually.

### What behaved differently than expected

- An empty list displayed **“undefined”** as though it were a list item. This appeared both when I first opened the app and after deleting everything.
- The long task was visibly cut off after “Plan Saturday errands: return”. It did not wrap or show an ellipsis, so most of the description was hidden.
- The filters appeared reversed:
  - **Active** showed only the completed “Buy oat milk” task.
  - **Completed** showed the two unfinished tasks.
- Renaming was confusing. Clicking **Save** updated the text but left the task in edit mode. Pressing **Enter** was required to finish editing and return to the normal task view.
- **Clear completed** did nothing, including when I tried it from the All view. I had to delete the completed task using its individual **Delete** button instead.
